notes:
Favorite teams, notch alerts and focus mode:
- Follow your teams: the widget switches to their matches and appears when they start (India also follows India A, Women, U-19; optional 'only my teams')
- Notch alerts: wickets in your other teams' matches, 50s and 100s, the last over, match start and result - even while the widget is paused
- Focus mode: hides during full-screen apps and video calls, and never shows up in screen shares or recordings
- New Teams & Alerts settings tab
